_comment: THE ONTOLOGY — single source of truth for what we know about each factor.
Read by: the fit (constraints + adjustment sets), the release gates (verification),
the bundle (shipped to the service), the service (roles/grades), the web (article links).
Replaces the four scattered copies (features.py, literature.py, seeds/features.json, evidence.json).
role          lever | manage | context | marker | baseline
source        fitted (estimated on the cohort) | literature (prior only, not in cohort)
sign          HARD constraint enforced in the optimizer: positive | negative | free
causes        DOWNSTREAM nodes — mediators; NEVER adjusted for in a total-effect estimand
confounded_by UPSTREAM common causes — always adjusted for
prior         literature effect size with a VERIFIED doi (Crossref-checked at the stated date)
study         slug into the service's study table

strata.rationale: 4 age bands x sex. Chosen on measured deaths per stratum (min 66) and on the sign of the young-smoking term, which is negative unstratified and positive under every candidate split. The exact figures are asserted by tests/test_golden.py rather than restated here.

age.note: Exogenous. Not in the linear predictor: handled by age-band strata plus the national life table.

sex.note: Exogenous. Stratum dimension, not a coefficient.

education.note: Upstream social cause of every behaviour. Explained, never recommended.

prior.title: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Health in 22 European Countries

education.clip_reason: Education's own effect is not detectable in this cohort once the fit is stratified by age and sex (+0.006 unconstrained, i.e. noise pointing the wrong way). The constraint holds it at 0 rather than letting noise read as 'school shortens your life'; it simply drops out of the breakdown.

smk_current.note: Quitting: the former-smoker coefficient carries sick-quitter bias, so What-If models cessation as trending to never-smoker (the causal target).
smk_current.waiver_reason: Perceived stress is a literature feature with no cohort measurement, so it cannot be adjusted for. Residual confounding by stress would, if anything, inflate the smoking coefficient.

activity.assumption: activity -> waist taken as the dominant direction of a real feedback loop (energy balance); the reverse (adiposity limits activity) is secondary at population level.

prior.title: Daily Sitting Time and All-Cause Mortality: A Meta-Analysis

standardizer.source: assumed from the Chau 2013 dose-response range

prior.title: Sleep Duration and All-Cause Mortality: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

sleep_long.decision: DEMOTED from lever to marker (ONT-01, 2026-09-09). The association is real and it predicts, but the dominant causal direction is illness -> long sleep, not long sleep -> death. Recommending less sleep would be advice with no evidence of benefit and a real risk of harm. Predicts and explains; never recommended, never a What-If target.

prior.title: Central fatness and risk of all cause mortality: systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis

waist.assumption: waist -> mobility taken as the dominant direction of a feedback loop.
waist.note: smoking -> waist is NEGATIVE (nicotine suppresses appetite), which is why smoking is a CONFOUNDER of the waist-mortality effect and must be adjusted for.
waist.waiver_reason: Diet, alcohol and sitting time are literature features: NHANES carries no usable item-level batteries for them, so they cannot enter a cohort-fitted adjustment set. The waist total effect is therefore adjusted for age, sex, smoking, activity and SES but NOT for these three. Recorded so the estimate is read as partially adjusted rather than fully causal.
waist.clip_reason: In the PREDICTION model — which conditions on diabetes, blood pressure and mobility, the very paths adiposity acts through — the direct effect of waist is slightly negative (-0.134). We do not believe adiposity protects anyone, and refuse to show a number that says so, so the sign constraint holds it at 0: waist does not move the headline estimate, while its TOTAL effect (+0.011 from the cohort) is what What-If and the recommendations use. Owner decision, ONT-01 Q3.

mobility.decision: Classified as MARKER, not context: difficulty walking is downstream evidence of accumulated damage rather than a cause of death, so it predicts and explains but is never recommended or offered in What-If.
